## The idea

A clear description of what you'd like to see.

## Why?

What problem does it solve, or who does it help shame?

## Anything else?

Mockups, examples from other sites, prior art.

> Note: some things are out of scope by design — accounts, numeric scores/grades,
> and ranked lists other than Tranco. See `docs/architecture.md`.
